context: A teen describes a suspicious-looking acquaintance to her aunt
purpose: Teach: いかにも/網/打っ/満ち/回避/っぱなし/じっと/マル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 叔母さん、この前駅前で会った人ね、いかにも怪しそうだったの。
lines.en: Auntie, that person I met in front of the station the other day looked really suspicious.
lines.style: Teen sharing gossip with trusted aunt, casual confiding tone

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あら、どんな感じだったの?ちょっと詳しく話してみて。
lines.en: Oh my, what kind of vibe was it? Tell me a bit more about it.
lines.style: Aunt gently encouraging niece to share, warm but curious

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 全身真っ黒で、首には太い金のチェーンしてて、こっちをじっと見てくるんだよ。
lines.en: Dressed all in black, a thick gold chain around the neck, and just staring at me.
lines.style: Teen describing details vividly, slightly nervous and animated

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: うわ、それは警戒心に満ちた感じね。目を合わせるのは回避したほうがいいわ。
lines.en: Ugh, that sounds full of warning signs. Better to avoid making eye contact.
lines.style: Aunt giving practical adult advice with concerned protective undertone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それがさ、向こうから話しかけてきて、肩をぽんって打ってきたんだよ、馴れ馴れしく。
lines.en: And then, he started talking to me and tapped my shoulder, way too familiar.
lines.style: Teen escalating story with shocked emphasis, hands probably gesturing

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 信用しちゃダメよ。そういう人は獲物を網にかけるみたいに狙ってくるから。
lines.en: Don't trust him. People like that target you as if catching prey in a net.
lines.style: Aunt stern warning using vivid metaphor, older protective relative tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しかも電話番号教えてって言われて、断ったのに着信入りっぱなしなの。
lines.en: On top of that, he asked for my number, and even though I refused, the calls keep coming.
lines.style: Teen showing frustration and mild fear, voice rising in disbelief

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: それはもう要注意人物の名前にマルつけとくレベルよ。お母さんにもちゃんと話しておきなさい。
lines.en: That's the level where you put a circle next to his name as someone to watch out for. Make sure to tell your mom too.
lines.style: Aunt giving firm protective directive with light humor, treating it seriously
